description: Rust-based pose outlier filter for high-performance filtering of pose measurements to reject outliers using predictive gating based on historical pose data and constant velocity assumptions

history_size.description: Maximum number of accepted poses to keep in history for velocity estimation

base_sigma.description: Base uncertainty for position predictions in meters

growth_rate.description: Rate at which uncertainty grows with consecutive rejections

gate_k.description: Multiplier for uncertainty to create gating threshold

max_consecutive_rejections.description: Maximum consecutive rejections before relaxing gate or resetting filter

relax_factor.description: Factor by which to relax gate threshold when max rejections reached

angular_gate_threshold.description: Maximum angular difference in radians for pose acceptance

velocity_smoothing_alpha.description: Smoothing factor for velocity estimates (0 = no smoothing, 1 = instant update)

full_reset_threshold.description: Number of consecutive rejections to trigger full filter reset
